inlines.v: COSMETIC, adjective s as z. [Gr., order, beauty.] Beautifying; improving beauty, particularly the beauty of the skin. COSMETIC, noun Any preparation that renders the skin soft, pure and white, and helps to beautify and improve the complexion.
